# Ambrose

[Grit](../codex/factions.md#grit)

## Overview

- **Age:** roughly fifty (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Role:** clergyman  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ambrose maintains an unkempt physical appearance marked by an unshaven face and long, untrimmed hair. This untamed look stems from a personal vow to forgo grooming until a specific victory was achieved.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)_

## Personality

Ambrose Kerr is an exceedingly resolute individual with a somewhat quick temper. Possessing the physical strength of an ox, he is also an entertaining storyteller and an excellent tenor who performs old Scotch ballads.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## History

In his younger years, Ambrose was a famous dancer who campaigned fiercely during a general election fifteen years prior, swearing he would not shave his face or trim his hair until the Liberals won power. He maintained this vow while residing near the [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) lighthouse, where he spent a New Year's Eve singing and performing an exhilarating dance with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). After the Liberals eventually secured an election victory, Ambrose shaved his long-kept beard, rendering him temporarily unrecognizable to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Shortly after his transformation, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) announced her upcoming marriage to him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), +10 more_

## Relationships

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ambrose--uncle-saul.md)

Ambrose Kerr and Captain [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) are acquaintances and fishing companions. [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) often shares stories about Ambrose with local visitors, such as explaining Ambrose's political vow regarding his unkempt hair and beard. The two also gather together at the lighthouse on occasions like New Year's Eve, where Ambrose entertains [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) and other guests with songs and dancing.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), +7 more_

- Friend of — acquaintances and fishing companions (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P18](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0018)</sub>
